sourceFile: 67. TIU L5S3-01 R REPORT TEST CHANGE TEMPERATURE COIL FORMING 500 - 2026.01.15_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft is not reliable because the changed factor and condition grouping are misidentified despite citeable source evidence.
issues: Changed factor is filename, not coil forming temperature.
Baseline and changed conditions are wrongly marked not explicit.
Outcomes aggregate headers/statistics instead of row-level defect rates.
Secondary condition after dry is not preserved.
requiredUserQuestions: Should 490°C be included as a separate test condition in this case?
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to coil forming temperature.
Define baseline as normal 480°C and tests as 500°C and 490°C if included.
Use AWF number and after-dry status as subgroup keys.
Rebuild outcomes from BAKO and HEARING defects plus total rate per condition.
Cite header rows and all condition rows used for comparisons.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Current citations are insufficient; final evidence must cite condition rows, not headers only.
